concept: desert fish shaped grilled bun taiyaki
author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a generic fish (round body, sharp triangle tail, big eye dot) with none of the reference's taiyaki cues; redrawn as the plump bun: rounded body with a blunt nose, pinched waist, broad rounded tail with a centre notch, and the two scale arcs from the reference.
omissions: Eye dot omitted (a dot beside a scale arc reads as a winking face).
